title: Reading a Standard Contract
text:
A standard contract sets out the rights and duties of each party. Before signing, both sides should read every clause carefully. Ambiguous wording can lead to disputes that take years to resolve.

Many contracts include a governing law clause, which states the legal system used to interpret the agreement. Parties may also agree on a method for resolving disagreements, such as arbitration. Such clauses are designed to save time and money.

questions.text: What does a standard contract set out?
options: the rights and duties of each party
the price of the goods only
the date of the next meeting

questions.text: What does a governing law clause state?
options: the payment schedule for the contract
the legal system used to interpret the agreement
the way to end the contract early

questions.text: Why should both sides read every clause carefully before signing?
options: to avoid disputes caused by unclear wording
to delay the signing as much as possible
to hide their real intentions from each other

questions.text: What is the main purpose of agreeing on arbitration?
options: to increase the total price of the agreement
to avoid signing the contract at all
to resolve disagreements without long court cases
to replace the governing law clause

vocabulary.definition: having more than one possible meaning
a separate section of a legal document
settling a dispute with a neutral third party instead of a court

paragraph_translations: Стандартний договір визначає права й обов'язки кожної сторони. Перед підписанням обидві сторони мають уважно прочитати кожен пункт. Двозначне формулювання може призвести до суперечок, які тривають роками.

Багато договорів містять пункт про застосовне право, який визначає правову систему для тлумачення угоди. Сторони також можуть погодити спосіб вирішення розбіжностей, наприклад арбітраж. Такі пункти покликані заощадити час і гроші.
